CREATE TABLE users (

    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL
);

);

+// at most maxTargetLen characters, a custom slug is [a-z0-9-]{3,32}, and a
+// user may create at most newLinksPerHour links per hour.

+	slugMinLen      = 3

+	newLinksPerHour = 30

+	// target, a 32-character slug and the syntax around them.
+	maxLinkBody = 4096
+)

+// slugAlphabet is what an auto-generated slug is built from: the characters a
+// custom slug allows, so a generated one reads the same as a chosen one.
+const slugAlphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-"
+
+// linkJSON is a link as the API speaks it. created_at is UTC RFC 3339.
+type linkJSON struct {
+	Slug        string `json:"slug"`
+	URL         string `json:"url"`
+	TotalClicks int64  `json:"clicks"`
+	CreatedAt   string `json:"created_at"`
+}

+	addRoutes(func(s *Server) {
+		s.HandleFunc("POST /api/links", s.createLink)

+// JSON or names no acceptable URL, 429 when the hour's quota is used up, 409
+// when the slug is taken and 201 with the new link otherwise.

+	userID, ok := requireUser(w, r)
+	if !ok {
+		return

+	body, err := readLinkBody(w, r)
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}
+	var req struct {
+		URL  string `json:"url"`
+		Slug string `json:"slug"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}
+	target, ok := validTargetURL(req.URL)
+	if !ok {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}
+	slug := strings.TrimSpace(req.Slug)

+		if slug, err = randomSlug(); err != nil {
+			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+			return

+		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}

+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return

+		writeError(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests)
+		return

+	if err != nil {

+		return

+// whether the link exists.

+// nothing but the bytes already sent.

+	body := http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxLinkBody)

+	return io.ReadAll(body)

+
+// validTargetURL accepts an absolute http or https URL with a host, of at most
+// maxTargetLen characters, and returns it trimmed.
+func validTargetURL(raw string) (string, bool) {
+	raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
+	if raw == "" || len(raw) > maxTargetLen {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	u, err := url.Parse(raw)

+		return "", false
+	}

+		return "", false
+	}
+	return raw, true

+
+// validSlug reports whether a custom slug is [a-z0-9-]{3,32}. It need not read

+func validSlug(slug string) bool {
+	if len(slug) < slugMinLen || len(slug) > slugMaxLen {
+		return false

+	for i := 0; i < len(slug); i++ {
+		c := slug[i]

+			continue
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return true

+// randomSlug is autoSlugLen characters of crypto/rand over slugAlphabet. A
+// clash with an existing slug is the store's 409 answer, not retried here.
+func randomSlug() (string, error) {
+	buf := make([]byte, autoSlugLen)
+	if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	slug := make([]byte, autoSlugLen)
+	for i, b := range buf {
+		slug[i] = slugAlphabet[int(b)%len(slugAlphabet)]
+	}
+	return string(slug), nil
+}

+// listLinks answers the logged-in user's own links, newest first, each with

+func (s *Server) listLinks(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	userID, ok := requireUser(w, r)
+	if !ok {
+		return
+	}
+	links, err := s.store.ListLinksByUser(r.Context(), userID)
+	if err != nil {
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}

+	}

+// belongs to someone else answers 404, which tells the caller nothing about
+// whether the link exists.
+func (s *Server) deleteLink(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError)

+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)

+func linkOut(l *store.Link) linkJSON {
+	return linkJSON{
